Voltgrid sets nameplate production capacity for its Texas plant

Voltgrid Corp said the expanded Texas plant has a nameplate production capacity of 120,000 tpa once the second line is commissioned, with the capacity expansion cost estimated by management at a level in line with its earlier guidance.

The company described the capacity expansion as the main driver of its order backlog conversion and expects the second line to ramp up during the first half of next year.
